description:
Convert GeoJSON to FlatGeobuf (.fgb) — the cloud-native binary
    format with a built-in spatial index. FlatGeobuf holds one geometry
    type per file, so mixed point/line/polygon input is automatically
    split into one .fgb per category and returned inside a zip.

    Returns JSON: {flatgeobuf_base64|flatgeobuf_zip_base64: str, split: bool,
    split_categories: [str]|null}.
name: geojson_to_flatgeobuf
